sights.n: Sapporo Concert Hall Kitara (札幌コンサートホールKitara)
sights.address: Nakajima Kōen 1-15, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: Hokkaido's first dedicated concert hall and home of the Sapporo Symphony Orchestra — a glass-walled hall in Nakajima Park famed for its soft, deep acoustics.

sights.n: Hokkaido University Museum (北海道大学総合博物館)
sights.address: Kita 10-jō Nishi 8-chōme, Kita-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: A 1929 scratch-tile campus building holding 3 million+ specimens gathered over 140 years — free, 10 minutes' walk from Sapporo Station.
sources: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/北海道大学総合博物館

sights.n: Migishi Kōtarō Museum of Art, Hokkaido (北海道立三岸好太郎美術館)
sights.address: Kita 2-jō Nishi 15-chōme, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: Devoted to the Sapporo-born modernist painter who died at 31, with a reproduction of his atelier.
sources: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/北海道立三岸好太郎美術館

sights.n: Hokkaido Museum of Literature (北海道立文学館)
sights.address: Nakajima Kōen 1-4, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: Inside Nakajima Park: Hokkaido's literature from Ainu oral epics to Takiji Kobayashi and Ayako Miura — some 260,000 items.

sights.n: Nopporo Forest Park (野幌森林公園)
sights.w: 2,053 ha of lowland forest on Sapporo's edge — 17 trails through a wildlife sanctuary of Ezo squirrels and 150 bird species; the Hokkaido Museum and Historical Village sit at its edge.
sources: https://ja.wikipedia.org/wiki/道立自然公園野幌森林公園

sights.w: A quiet 1883 hot-spring hamlet on the Toyohira River, 5 km short of Jōzankei — settlers found the water under a giant katsura tree.

sights.n: ES CON FIELD HOKKAIDO — Hokkaido Ballpark F Village (エスコンフィールドHOKKAIDO)
sights.address: Hokkaido Ballpark F Village, Kitahiroshima, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: The Fighters' 2023 retractable-roof ballpark at the heart of a 32-ha 'F Village' — with TOWER 11's natural hot spring and sauna overlooking the field; parts open free on non-game days.
Sapporo's largest ski area, 40 minutes from downtown, with two 1972 Winter Olympic runs — the Olympic torch still overlooks the city and the Sea of Japan.

sights.n: Sapporo Kokusai Ski Resort (札幌国際スキー場)
sights.w: Under an hour from the city yet with Niseko-rivalling snowfall — a 3.6 km forest trail and a 100 m-wide family run.

sights.n: Sapporo City Astronomical Observatory (札幌市天文台)
sights.address: Nakajima Kōen 1, Chuo-ku, Sapporo, Hokkaido, Japan
sights.w: A 1958 public observatory in Nakajima Park with a 20 cm refractor — free night-time stargazing on six evenings a month.
